ex: r2r-town-9: Ingvar Bjornsson (the lord) ← Ulf Ulfsson (Alderman): Ulf Ulfsson holds the debts Ingvar Bjornsson has run up, and so Ulf Ulfsson decides what Ingvar Bjornsson can afford to do.

r2r-metropolis-32: Decimia Capito (the lord) ← Hadrian Laevinus (Master of the Guilds): Decimia Capito owes Hadrian Laevinus more than the settlement collects in two years of taxes. Hadrian Laevinus is paid first, every quarter.

r2s-recently_betrayed-city-2: Ériu MacGillivray (the lord) ← Fionnuala MacRae (Speaker of the Assembly): Fionnuala MacRae lends and Ériu MacGillivray spends. The council's decisions are made in Ériu MacGillivray's chamber and approved in Fionnuala MacRae's counting-house.

r2s-succession_void-metropolis-2: Walid al-Din (the lord) ← Kausar al-Nuri (First Magnate): Kausar al-Nuri lends and Walid al-Din spends. The council's decisions are made in Walid al-Din's chamber and approved in Kausar al-Nuri's counting-house.
r2s-succession_void-metropolis-3: Wershi Timurid (the lord) ← Luvsandorj Budaad (Doge): Wershi Timurid governs on Luvsandorj Budaad's credit. Every loan renewed adds one more condition to the next.

r2s-succession_void-metropolis-3: Ügedei Jirgin (the lord) ← Luvsandorj Budaad (Doge): Ügedei Jirgin pays for the common works with money borrowed from Luvsandorj Budaad. Ügedei Jirgin cannot cross Luvsandorj Budaad, and Luvsandorj Budaad makes sure Ügedei Jirgin remembers it.
